By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. title: Transmission Line Engineer II/ III- High Voltage
description:
Role Summary

As a Transmission Line Engineer II/III, you will design the overhead high- and medium-voltage lines that connect utility-scale solar and battery storage projects to the grid. A gen-tie line is often the last link between a finished plant and the energy it delivers, and your work decides whether that link is safe, buildable, and cost-effective. You will turn project requirements into construction-ready designs, working alongside substation, protection and controls, and civil engineers on the High Voltage team. The work you produce will directly support the addition of utility-scale renewable energy generation assets to the power grid.

As an employee-owner, you will share in the results of the work and help build a team where every engineer's contribution is recognized. Candidates may be considered at either the Engineer II or Engineer III level depending on experience, technical depth, independence, and demonstrated ability to lead scope.

Duties & Responsibilities

Across both levels, this role may include:

**Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities**

* Design overhead gen-tie, transmission, and medium-voltage lines in PLS-CADD, including route evaluation, plan and profile development, structure spotting, sag-tension analysis, conductor selection, and clearance verification.

* Model and check wood, steel, and concrete pole structures and lattice towers in PLS-POLE and PLS-TOWER under the governing load cases.

* Prepare structure load sheets and specifications for custom steel poles, and review fabricator drawings for conformance with the design.

* Develop insulator and hardware assemblies, framing details, and bills of material.

* Design or coordinate direct-embed and drilled pier foundations using geotechnical reports and foundation design software.

* Build terrain models and crossing data from LiDAR and survey files for use in line design.

* Produce development, permitting, and issued-for-construction drawing and specification packages.
